title: Computer Vision–Based Jaw Automation
label: Case Study · KIPIPL
subtitle: Real-time feeder monitoring and automated control for smarter jaw crusher operation.
excerpt: How computer vision helps KIPIPL monitor feeder conditions and automate jaw crusher feeding.
cover_alt: Illustration of a jaw crusher monitored by a camera and AI system, with live feeder status and automated controls.
cover_caption: Computer vision monitors feeder conditions for automated crusher control.
overview: A CCTV-based vision system monitors feeder conditions in real time, helping automate jaw crusher operation and reduce manual monitoring.
overview_note: At KIPIPL, innovation supports smarter mining and manufacturing.

sections.label: THE CHALLENGE
sections.headline: Manual feeder monitoring caused inconsistent feeding, idle running, and overloading.
points: Operators had to monitor feeding continuously.

sections.headline: Self-regulating automation supports consistent, reliable crusher operation.
